title: Bijliyaa Girti Thi Qalbe Zainab e Dilgeer Par
body:
Bijliyan girti thi qalbey Zainab-e-dilgeer par
Marta tha jab chadi zalim laabe besheer par
Khud rasool-e-kibriya bhi gham mein tere aye Hussain… khud rasool-e-kibriya bhi gham mein tere aye Hussain… khoon key aansu bahaye chadar-e-tatheer par
Ham ko khudrath ney kiya paida isi gham key liye… ham ko khudrath ney kiya paida isi gham key liye… naaz karte hein hamesha apni ham taqdeer par
<<DIVIDER>>
Chodkar shamsheer-e-ghazi lee chale mashkl-o-alam… chodkar shamsheer-e-ghazi lee chale mashkl-o-alam… hukmein sheh paakar na daali ek nazar shamsheer par
Dedi maidan ki ijazath Qasim-e-nousha ko… dedi maidan ki ijazath Qasim-e-nousha ko… shahdeen ne jab nazar ki bhai ki tehreer par
Tha zabaan par jiski hardam ya mohammed ya nabi… tha zabaan par jiski hardam ya mohammed ya nabi… teer barsaye wohi tou apki tasveer par
Waqt-e-aaqir kardiya uske hawale ghar ka ghar… waqt-e-aaqir kardiya uske hawale ghar ka ghar… tha bharosa is qadar shabbir ko hamsheer par
<<DIVIDER>>
Sinaye Sarwar chuta ghouhar cheene kurta jala… sinaye Sarwar chuta ghouhar cheene kurta jala… kamsini mein thi qayamath duqtare shabbir par
Har khadam aada lagaye Karbala se Shaam tak… har khadam aada lagaye Karbala se Shaam tak… taziyane aur koode Abid-e-dilgir par
Shayar-e-aale nabi hai aur zawwar-e-Hussain… shayar-e-aale nabi hai aur zawwar-e-Hussain… kyun na Mazhar haq tera ho khuldi jaagir par
